title: Varshil of Undying
description: This Resource Pack changes the totem texture to VarshilMinex!
body:
**Description**
____________________________________________________________________________________________
This texture pack changes the totem of undying to my Minecraft skin. You can also replace the texture with any Minecraft skin at all like an emo skin, gamer skin, etc.
